WITH eq_avg AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humepct
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM eq_avg
),
above_group AS (
  SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humepct
  FROM eq_avg e
  CROSS JOIN overall_ref o
  WHERE e.avg_humepct > o.overall_avg
),
group_ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humepct) AS group_mean
  FROM above_group
)
SELECT a.equipref AS equipment_ref,
       a.avg_humepct AS avg_humidity,
       a.avg_humepct - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall,
       a.avg_humepct - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above_group a
CROSS JOIN overall_ref o
CROSS JOIN group_ref g
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
